_about: Per-attack overrides for the attack-text compiler (src/attack_text.py), merged on top of what it parses. Key: 'Card Name|Attack Name'. Fields are spec fields (see attack_text.py); 'typical' = [expected, max] damage for deck-level scoring; 'unparsed': [] marks the text as handled. Patch only what a general rule shouldn't cover.

N's Zoroark ex|Night Joker.note: Copies a Benched N's Pokemon's attack (N's Zekrom Rampaging Thunder 250 / Shred 70) for its own 2-Energy cost. The board-aware estimator resolves the copy; 'typical' is for deck scoring.

Alakazam|Strange Hacking.note: No damage of its own: confuses, then redistributes the opponent's existing damage counters (can turn spread into Knock Outs). Not modelled as damage.

Sinistcha|Matcha Spin.note: 4 counters on EACH opponent Pokemon once 6+ Hide 'n Sneak Pokemon are in the discard pile.

Spiritomb|Spiritual End.note: With 13+ Hide 'n Sneak Pokemon in the discard pile, quadruples the counters on 2 opponent Pokemon. Late-game finisher; not modelled on the board.
effects: quadruple damage counters on 2 opponent Pokemon (13+ Hide 'n Sneak in discard)

Mega Absol ex|Terminal Period.note: Knocks Out the opponent's Active if it has exactly 6 damage counters.

Arboliva ex|Oil Salvo.note: 6 x 20 damage spread as you like, not affected by Weakness/Resistance: modelled as 12 freely placed counters.

Spectrier|Phantasmal Barrage.note: 12 counters on 1 opponent Pokemon (any), discarding all Energy from Spectrier.

Team Rocket's Sneasel|Strike the Sleeper.note: 20 x damage counters already on 1 Benched opponent Pokemon. Scales with existing Bench damage; not modelled on the board.
effects: bench snipe scaling with existing counters

Cofagrigus|Law of the Underworld.note: 6 counters on every Pokemon with an Ability, both sides.
effects: 6 counters on each Pokemon with an Ability (both sides)

Cofagrigus|Extended Damagriiigus.note: Moves all counters from 1 of your Benched Pokemon to 1 opponent Pokemon.
effects: move own Bench damage to an opponent Pokemon

Pawmot|Voltaic Fist.note: Optional: 60 self-damage to Paralyze the opponent's Active.
